title: EffectiveAutonomy
description: Live effective autonomy state observable at .council/state/effective-autonomy.json. Written by scripts/update-effective-autonomy.py on every change (R10/Q20/§11.11 NEW v2).

level.description: Current effective autonomy level (0–5). May differ from nominal level due to dynamic floor drops (R10).

last_change.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent level change.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the current level is what it is (e.g. 'Two consecutive sprint FAILs in sprints 4 and 5 — dropped from L4 to L3 per R10').

restored_when.description: Description of the condition that will restore the nominal level (e.g. 'After 1 PASS'). Null if already at nominal level.

trigger_history.description: Most recent N trigger events (default 10) for debugging and pull-rate analysis. Each item records a level transition event.

trigger_type.description: Type of event that caused this level transition.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this trigger occurred.

from_level.description: Effective autonomy level before this transition.

to_level.description: Effective autonomy level after this transition.

triggered_by.description: Agent ID or event source that triggered this transition.

linked_henka_id.description: HK-NNNN of the henkaten record that triggered this transition, if any.
